about: Nodes of the meteorology lineage graph, type "body": who runs it. Ids are stable (incident.entities@ may adopt them); meaning is in the edges (meteorology/edges/), not here. Joins, each a fact we state and not a match: "entity" (this node is the same thing as that entity in entities/), "of" (a site node: the entity that publishes the site), "source" (the id in sources/registry.json of the same thing).

nodes.name: World Meteorological Organization
nodes.summary: The United Nations agency under which countries exchange observations and forecasts (the Global Observing System, the WMO Information System).

nodes.name: ECMWF
nodes.summary: The European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts: an intergovernmental organisation of 35 states (Portugal is a member).

nodes.name: EUMETSAT
nodes.summary: Europe's meteorological satellite agency (Meteosat, Metop), an intergovernmental organisation.

nodes.name: EUMETNET
nodes.summary: The network of European national meteorological services; it runs shared programmes (OPERA radar, E-SURFMAR, MeteoAlarm).

nodes.name: NOAA (NWS, NCEP, NESDIS)
nodes.summary: The United States' weather and ocean agency: runs GFS, the National Hurricane Center and the GOES and JPSS satellites.

nodes.name: Deutscher Wetterdienst
nodes.summary: Germany's national meteorological service; runs ICON.

nodes.name: Météo-France
nodes.summary: France's national meteorological service; runs ARPEGE and AROME.

nodes.name: Met Office
nodes.summary: The United Kingdom's national meteorological service; runs the Unified Model.

nodes.name: IPMA
nodes.summary: Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera: Portugal's national meteorological service and the only body that issues weather warnings for Portugal.

nodes.name: AEMET
nodes.summary: Agencia Estatal de Meteorología: Spain's national meteorological service.

nodes.name: MET Norway
nodes.summary: The Norwegian Meteorological Institute; publishes a free global forecast API and, with NRK, the Yr service.

nodes.name: Copernicus (European Union)
nodes.summary: The EU's Earth observation programme; ECMWF, EUMETSAT and Mercator Ocean run services for it.

nodes.name: The Open-Meteo project
nodes.summary: A small open-source company in Switzerland behind the Open-Meteo API.

nodes.name: MeteoGroup (DTN)
nodes.summary: A commercial forecast provider, part of DTN; named by BBC Weather as its partner.

nodes.name: Instituto Hidrográfico
nodes.summary: The Portuguese Navy's hydrographic institute: wave buoys, tide gauges and the official tide predictions.
